ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between low-intensity (black) pixels along the distal margins and high-intensity (white) pixels in the medial regions, though the latter are heavily blended with water spray pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and distal tips; the central lobe regions exhibit high-frequency white and black mottling with irregular geometric blobs, though the inferior portion of the fluke is obscured by water splash.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 150 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from approximately 5-15 pixels from the mean boundary line across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the upper visible boundary of both the left and right lobes.
